    AI Overview
    Banana Ball is a fast-paced, entertainment-focused version of baseball created by the Savannah Bananas, featuring strict rules like a two-hour time limit, no bunting, and fans catching foul balls for outs. Known as "the greatest show on earth," it features dancing players, choreography, and high-energy fan interaction, often compared to the Harlem Globetrotters of baseball. 
    Key 2026 Banana Ball Rules & Features 
    • Point System: Points are awarded per inning; the team with the most runs in an inning wins one point, with all runs counting in the final inning.
    • No Bunting/Step Outs: Batters cannot bunt or step out of the box.
    • Fan Outs: Foul balls caught by fans in the stands are counted as outs.
    • Steal First: Batters can steal first base at any time, including on wild pitches or passed balls.
    • Showdown Tiebreaker: If tied after two hours, a "showdown" (1-on-1 batter vs. pitcher) resolves the game.
    • Golden Batter: A team can choose any hitter in their lineup to bat once per game. 
    2026 World Tour & Broadcasts 
    • TNT Sports Deal: Starting May 8, 2026, 15 exclusive games will air on truTV and HBO Max, with games at venues like Coors Field, Kauffman Stadium, and Gillette Stadium.
    • The Teams: The tour features the Savannah Bananas, Party Animals, and Texas Tailgaters.
    • Tickets: Tickets are sold via an official lottery system on the Savannah Bananas website. 
    For more information, you can explore the official Savannah Bananas website.
